ddl.value:
(
                ("transaction_type" in ('Receive', 'Produce') and "qty_change" > 0)
                or ("transaction_type" in ('Consume', 'Scrap') and "qty_change" < 0)
                or ("transaction_type" in ('Transfer', 'Adjustment'))
            )
ddl.name: txn_sign_matches_type

ddl.value:
(
                ("transaction_type" <> 'Receive' or "po_line_id" is not null)
                and ("transaction_type" not in ('Consume', 'Produce') or "packing_order_id" is not null)
                and ("transaction_type" not in ('Scrap', 'Adjustment') or "reason_id" is not null)
                and ("transaction_type" <> 'Transfer' or "transfer_line_id" is not null)
            )
ddl.name: txn_required_links

ddl.value: "expiration_date" is null or "manufacture_date" is null or "expiration_date" > "manufacture_date"
ddl.name: lots_dates_valid

ddl.value: "completed_at" is null or "started_at" is null or "completed_at" >= "started_at"
ddl.name: packing_dates_valid

ddl.value:
("dispatched_at" is null or "dispatched_at" >= "requested_at")
                and ("received_at" is null or "dispatched_at" is null or "received_at" >= "dispatched_at")
ddl.name: transfer_dates_valid
